primary.target: At least16/32 banks lose at least one true edge under histogram-preserving permutation noise.

corruption_law_audit.multiset_theorem: A permutation is a bijection of all81 source positions, so every digit multiplicity stays exactly9. Any25-cell subset has each multiplicity<=9; the balance filter necessarily accepts it.
corruption_law_audit.uniform_permutation_law: A uniform permutation maps any fixed position uniformly to81 sources and any ordered pair of distinct positions uniformly to6480 ordered distinct sources. Exact pair counts checked above; no factorial enumeration claim.

theorem_scope: Uniform position permutations conserve nine copies of each digit; every25-cell subset passes the balance filter. Every repeated query on a board shares one output. This is mathematically separate from finite-bank pruning failures.
source_scope: Same already-seen H1an sources and tie/cell streams; new permutation-noise streams. Archived collapse results are descriptive controls. The unfiltered trajectory is independently replayed from the identical observed stream, not redundantly reacquired.
limitations: Specific board-shared position-permutation law, not arbitrary correlation.
Source banks reused from H1an; no fresh-source claim.
Scalar iid calibration is deliberately misspecified.
Global digit-balance prior does not establish cleanliness under this law.
No solver accuracy or invalid-certificate measurement. BP AdamW outside source-only scope; not run.

runtime.accounting: Process user+system CPU for this orchestrator and all reaped children; active child CPU polled from /proc. OMP/OpenBLAS/MKL threads fixed to1.
